edges.reason: botProtection address is used as the target of the low-level external call in the checkBots modifier.
Execution of the checkBots modifier triggers the external call before the function body.
External call to the bot protection contract executes untrusted code before the modified function's state updates.
The modifier's external call runs before transferFrom mutates balances and allowances.
uniPair is passed as an argument into the encoded external call.
The owner-only delegate function performs an arbitrary delegatecall.
msg.sender is compared against owner to gate the delegatecall.
owner state variable is used in the access control require of delegate.
Arbitrary delegatecall can overwrite the owner storage slot due to delegated storage context.
msg.sender is used for the allowance check inside transferFrom.
msg.sender is forwarded as the sender argument from transfer to transferFrom.
transfer delegates all execution to transferFrom.
allowance mapping is read to validate the spending amount.
balanceOf mapping is read to validate the transfer amount.
allowance mapping is decremented inside transferFrom.
balanceOf mappings of sender and recipient are updated inside transferFrom.
transferFrom performs raw subtraction of allowance and balances without SafeMath under Solidity 0.7.
allowance value flows into the unchecked subtraction.
balanceOf value flows into the unchecked subtraction and addition.
Result of the unchecked arithmetic is written back into balanceOf.
Result of the unchecked arithmetic is written back into allowance.
msg.sender is assigned to owner in the DELTAToken constructor.
owner state variable is initialized by the constructor.
uniPair is computed and stored during construction.
allowance entries are initialized to uint(-1) in the constructor.
Base constructor assigns the bot protection address storage variable.
pairFor result is assigned to uniPair.
wETH address is used as input to the pair computation.
msg.sender is compared with owner to gate the list function.
owner state variable is read in the require of list.
block.timestamp is used to derive the Uniswap deadline, making execution timestamp dependent.
uniRouter instance is invoked by list for addLiquidityETH.
totalSupply is used to compute the owner's listed balance.
list computes totalSupply * 6 / 100 with raw arithmetic.
totalSupply flows into the unchecked multiplication and division.
Result of the raw arithmetic is written into balanceOf.
list mass-assigns recipient balances in balanceOf.
ERC20.transfer calls _transfer.
ERC20.transferFrom calls _transfer.
ERC20.transferFrom calls _approve after SafeMath subtraction.
ERC20.approve calls _approve.
_transfer mutates the _balances mapping.
_mint mutates _totalSupply.
_burn mutates _totalSupply.
_approve mutates the _allowances mapping.
msg.sender is used as spender in the base transferFrom allowance update.
msg.sender is used as the sender in the base transfer path.
_botProtection parameter is stored by the base constructor.
checkBots _from parameter is encoded into the external call.
checkBots _to parameter is encoded into the external call.
checkBots _value parameter is encoded into the external call.
transferFrom _from parameter drives allowance and balance updates.
transferFrom _to parameter receives the credited balance.
transferFrom _value parameter determines the transferred amount.
approve _spender parameter is written into the allowance mapping.
approve _value parameter is written into the allowance mapping.
delegate target address parameter is used as the delegatecall target.
delegate data parameter is used as the delegatecall calldata.
list _numList parameter is used as liquidity amount and contract balance.
list _tos array drives the distribution loop.
list _amounts array drives the distribution loop.
Loop index i controls iteration in list.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor parameter _botProtection only feeds the base constructor assignment.
checkBots _from is only consumed by the external bot protection call.
checkBots _to is only consumed by the external bot protection call.
checkBots _value is only consumed by the external bot protection call.
transferFrom _from is only used within the transferFrom body.
transferFrom _to is only used within the transferFrom body.
transferFrom _value is only used within the transferFrom body.
approve _spender is only used within the approve body.
approve _value is only used within the approve body.
delegate address parameter is only used for the delegatecall target.
delegate bytes parameter is only used for the delegatecall data.
list _numList is only used inside the list function.
list _tos is only used inside the list function.
list _amounts is only used inside the list function.
Loop index i exists solely within the list function.
